Kaiyaṭa
son of Candrāditya; grandson of Vallabhadeva an. protege of Bhīmagupta of Kashmir (977-82 A. D.).
--C. on Ānandavardhana's Devīśataka composed in 977 A. D.
Pt.. K. M. Gucch. IX. p.. 1-31.

Kaiyaṭa
son of Jaiyaṭa an. pupil of Maheśvara. Ref. to Bhartṛhari's C. on Mahābhāṣya an. to Kāśikāvṛtti. 11th Cent. A. D. On 1150 A. D. a. his date, see V. Raghavan, JOR. Madras, XIX. iii. p.. 223-4. See also ABORI. XII. ii. p.. 246-51.
--C. Pradīpa or Kaiyaṭadīpa on Patañjali's Mahābhāṣya. [Page076-a.

Kaiyaṭa
--Pravartakīya. gr. Oppert I. 4222. II. 7644].
See C.. on Kaiyaṭa's Pradīpa, by Pravartaka, Taylor I. 91.

Kaiyaṭadīpa
or bhASyadIpa same a. C. Pradīpa by Kaiyaṭa on Mahābhāṣya. Paliyam 404 (b) (inc.).
